body.title: Add tests (core golden vectors + scripted-fake seam + editor source-scan) and verify locally
body.summary: LogModelTest (golden CLI-parity vectors for parseLogLine + matchesFilter + LogLevels), LogTailSeamTest (ScriptedLogTailFs fake: initial last-maxLines, append-only fresh-only via manual watch trigger, rotation reset, truncation re-tail, throwing-fake never-throws + valid dispose, idempotent close + post-dispose no-emit), and source-scan extensions. Per the s3 critique: put the 'Open in editor' affordance + LightVirtualFile/FileEditorManager source-scan in a NEW LogEditorSection/LogEditorSurface-targeted test file (opens via FileEditorManager into a user-read-only LightVirtualFile, off-EDT invokeLater/write action, dispose-on-close, NO delete/rotate/clear; section resolves a Project + degrades + opens in an editor not inline; default logDir /tmp/.insrc), and EXPLICITLY re-confirm the existing DebugPageTest ac2 (sole-mutating-control = the Kill button) still passes after the sections() append (add only the [status,orphans,mcp,log] append assertion to DebugPageTest). Verify locally: gradlew test buildPlugin (JDK21, --no-build-cache after new types).
acceptanceChecks: LogModelTest proves parseLogLine/matchesFilter/LogLevels CLI parity incl. no-level/no-module drops, non-JSON free-text, unknown-level; LogTailSeamTest proves rotation/append-only/truncation/never-throws/idempotent-dispose over the scripted fake

A NEW LogEditor-targeted source-scan asserts the read-only LightVirtualFile + FileEditorManager editor-tab surface, the off-EDT invokeLater/write action, dispose-on-close, no delete/rotate/clear, the Project-resolve+degrade, and the /tmp/.insrc default; DebugPageTest gains only the [status,orphans,mcp,log] append assertion and its existing ac2 sole-mutating-control assertion still passes
Full jetbrains-plugin test + buildPlugin green locally on JDK21

tests.name: LogEditorSurfaceTest + LogEditorSectionTest + DebugPageTest (assembled source-scans + append assertion + preserved ac2)
